title: What goes wrong with one smiley for every student?
description: A table of students present in eight classes is turned into a pictograph with one smiley for each student. Adding the smileys up shows how much time and space the drawing needs, and Keeko's doubt, that we can draw as many smileys as we like, is checked against the board.
teaching_notes: One idea: one symbol for each thing needs too many symbols when the counts are large, which is why a bigger symbol is chosen. Watch for students who think we can draw as many symbols as we like.

source: {{NAME_10}} and {{NAME_7}} have the table of students present (Class I 30, II 35, III 20, IV 25, V 30, VI 25, VII 30, VIII 20). If they want to show their data through a pictograph, where they also use one symbol (smiley) for each student, as {{NAME_5}} did, what are the challenges they might face?
video_script.why: The child sees that one symbol for each student needs far too many symbols when the counts are large, which prepares the idea of a bigger symbol.
video_script.substitution: Count the smileys the whole pictograph would need if each student were one smiley.
video_script.anchor: the table of students present in eight classes, and the rows of smileys drawn from it
video_script.wrong_answer: there is no problem, because we can draw as many smileys as we like
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks any number of smileys can be drawn, so the long rows are no trouble. The board and the time run out first.
video_script.payoff_line: Too many symbols are needed, and drawing them takes much time and space

final_answer.value: Too many symbols are needed (for example 35 for one class); drawing them takes much time and space
final_answer.spoken: too many symbols are needed, for example thirty five for one class, and drawing them takes much time and space

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks there is no problem, because we can draw as many smileys as we like.
<bookmark mark='room'/>But the board has only so much room, and time is limited too.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>That is why {{NAME_10}} used one smiley for five students, to save time and space.
